notes: Sony Japan publishes four listings; this schema describes the ZooKeep boards reached from sony.co.jp/recruit/mid-career (sonygroupcorp, sonycorp, sonysemiconductorsolutions). GET https://app.zookeep.com/api/public/career_site/{org}/job_postings/?search=&limit=&offset=&ordering=title is unfiltered; search=エンジニア returned 18 of 36 rows, so keyword search is native. The options endpoint (.../job_postings/options/) returns locations, function ids and employmentTypes but no filter parameter names; ?location= was ignored. The fourth listing, careers.playstation.com/ja/locations/tokyo/mid-professional/job, has no filter controls.
